children: Applied Digital closed a $300M delayed-draw term loan with a 364-day maturity at SOFR plus 300 basis points to fund Delta Forge 1 construction. Draws depend on specified conditions, and the company expects to seek additional financing to complete construction.
Provides near-term construction financing, but the short maturity creates a refinancing obligation; no prior-period comparison applies.
Floating-rate borrowing costs can rise with SOFR; the release gives no fixed-rate comparison.
Draws depend on milestones, approvals and covenants
The announced facility is not unconditional access to the full amount; delays or unmet conditions could constrain funding.
The facility alone is not stated to cover all completion costs, leaving further financing needs.

This is a mid-cycle financing update tied to construction of Delta Forge 1, backed by a long-term lease with a U.S.-based, tier-one investment-grade hyperscaler. Completion depends on satisfying draw conditions and securing additional financing.
